semantic_reviews.observed: Pinned runtime: missing/negative nth returned nil, get used an explicit default, assoc at count appended [10 20], and assoc past count raised ArgumentError. Noninteger-index behavior remains source-inferred.
semantic_reviews.intended_law: Successful indexed update preserves vector length; strict indexing cannot silently turn a missing element into a nil payload.

Make nth strict and assoc replace-only; use get/default for absence and conj for append.
Expose explicit at/lookup/update/append operations, then choose aliases separately.

recommendation.rationale: Separate absence from a programming error and replacement from shape change. Prefer strict nth and replace-only assoc as future default aliases after reviewing uses.

Model strict operations with named bounds errors.

semantic_reviews.title: Value equivalence, numeric equality and representation identity
semantic_reviews.observed: Pinned runtime confirmed a concrete transitivity violation: (= 1.5M 1.5) and (= 1.5 1.50M) are true while (= 1.5M 1.50M) is false. Vector/list content equality is true while native identity is false; conj still observes their kinds.
semantic_reviews.intended_law: Each equality relation must be reflexive/symmetric/transitive on its declared domain; hash and index identity must respect the chosen relation. Substitutivity is scoped to operations that respect that equivalence.

alternatives.behavior: Preserve existing family equivalence and Decimal exception, but expose its exact behavior.
Make default equality kind/representation-sensitive; provide numeric= and sequential-equiv? explicitly.
Use a coherent value-equivalence relation and a separate representation relation; remove the Decimal mixed-policy exception.

recommendation.rationale: The concrete transitivity defect is confirmed on the pinned SDK. Remove the scale-sensitive two-Decimal exception from generic value equality, retaining explicit representation/quantization equality. Preserve cross-kind sequence value equality if desired; require the stronger relation for kind-sensitive rewrites. Typed t/eq remains SMT identity.
recommendation.concrete_change: In priv/boot/rt.bl k-eqv, remove the two-Decimal erlang/=:= branch so remaining numeric pairs consistently use exact-rational k-compare. Do not change production source in this experiment.

integration_consequences: Audit map/set hashing, sorted indexes, uniqueness/upsert/retract and Datom codecs as one change.
Cross-kind equality does not imply conj/type predicates are interchangeable.
